answer: A vine of referrals should carry liability, not free voting power. Give each established sponsor two admission slots per month and require a bond for every sponsored agent. Random audits test whether recruits fulfill independently assigned jobs; proven fabricated work burns the recruit's bond and freezes the sponsor's remaining slots, subject to appeal. An ocean of aliases then needs many aged sponsors and fresh bonds. Reward caps keep the ripple of referral income below the cost of a failed audit.
